title: Distribution center safety walk, early shift
summary: Jordan, the early-shift lead at the DFW distribution center, opens the building and gets wave 1 out of dock 14. An hour in, Tasha finds a racking upright in aisle 22 buckled by a forklift: the aisle is taped off, FL-12 is pulled for a check, the inspector red-tags the bay, and the racking crew replaces the upright before noon. Meanwhile freezer FZ-1 starts alarming at -12C with an iced evaporator; the contractor can't come until tomorrow, so it is the open item at handoff.
style: Unedited first-person snapshot from a head-mounted wearable camera at eye level, deep focus with everything sharp, no bokeh, inside a large distribution center warehouse, slightly off-level framing, high-bay LED lighting, light sensor noise, realistic, no faces in frame (a coworker's gloved hands at most).

issues.title: Aisle 22 bay 07 racking upright buckled by forklift impact
Freezer FZ-1 high temperature, evaporator 2 iced

shots.prompt: A whiteboard in a warehouse shipping office with neat block-capital marker writing: header "EARLY SHIFT", then the lines "WAVE 1: 42 ORDERS" and "DOCK 14 TRAILER 5521"; a desk with a label printer below it.
shots.note: Opening up. Wave 1 is 42 orders out of dock 14.

shots.prompt: An open warehouse loading dock door with a trailer backed in and pallets of boxes; a large yellow sign above the door reads "DOCK 14".
An industrial forklift battery charger on a wall with a cable plugged into a forklift; a large label reads "CHG-05" and its display shows "78%".
Orange and blue steel pallet racking loaded with shrink-wrapped pallets; a large aisle sign reads "AISLE 22"; the uprights and beams are straight and intact.
Insulated walk-in freezer door with frost around the seal; a label reads "FZ-1" and a digital display beside it shows "-18C".

Looking down at the base of a blue steel pallet racking upright in aisle 22 that is badly bent and buckled inward from a forklift impact, with scraped paint and a dented base plate; loaded pallets above; a large white aisle sign reading "AISLE 22" is visible in the top of the frame.
shots.note: Forklift clipped the upright at bay 07 in aisle 22, it's buckled at the base.

shots.prompt: Yellow and black caution tape stretched across the end of a warehouse racking aisle with a printed sign hanging from it reading "AISLE 22 CLOSED"; tall loaded pallet racking beyond.
shots.note: Taped off aisle 22. The FL-12 driver reported it straight away.

shots.prompt: Close-up of the fork carriage of a yellow forklift with fresh blue paint scrapes on the steel; a large black stenciled marking on the mast reads "FL-12".
shots.note: Pulled FL-12 off the floor for a check: blue paint on the carriage matches the upright.

shots.prompt: A bright red inspection tag zip-tied to a bent blue steel pallet racking upright, the tag printed in large white letters "DO NOT USE - UNLOAD BAY", and a small label on the upright reads "BAY 07".
shots.note: Racking inspector red-tagged bay 07: unload it and replace the upright.

shots.prompt: A closed warehouse loading dock door with a green light lit beside it and a large yellow sign above the door reading "DOCK 14"; an empty pallet jack parked in front.
shots.note: Wave 1 shipped, trailer 5521 sealed and pulled from dock 14.

shots.prompt: Insulated stainless walk-in freezer door with frost around the seal; a large printed label on the door reads "FZ-1"; the digital temperature display beside the door shows "-12C" with a large red "ALARM" light lit above it.
Inside a walk-in freezer, looking up at a ceiling-mounted evaporator unit whose coil and fans are completely encased in thick white ice; a printed label on the unit housing reads "FZ-1 EVAP 2".
shots.note: Evaporator 2 is iced solid. Refrigeration contractor can't come until 7am tomorrow; moving the ice cream pallets to FZ-2.

shots.prompt: Looking down at the base of a brand-new, clean, glossy blue steel pallet racking upright with a new bolted base plate and fresh anchor bolts on the concrete floor; the lowest bay beside it is empty; a small label on the upright reads "BAY 07" and a green tag zip-tied to it reads "OK TO LOAD".
shots.note: Racking crew replaced the upright at bay 07 and the inspector cleared the bay. Aisle 22 is open again.

shots.prompt: A yellow forklift parked at a charging station with its charging cable plugged in; a large black stenciled "FL-12" on the mast and a green tag hanging from the overhead guard printed "INSPECTED OK".
shots.note: FL-12 passed its check, back on the floor after charging.

shots.prompt: The shipping office whiteboard, rewritten for the next shift.
shots.edit: change only the whiteboard writing: header "LATE SHIFT", then the lines "FZ-1 EVAP ICED - CONTRACTOR 7AM", "PRODUCT IN FZ-2", and "AISLE 22 OPEN", in the same neat block-capital marker.
shots.note: Board updated for late shift: FZ-1 still warm, contractor 7am.
